entities.name: Symond Halm
entities.description: Playwright and debtor of Ilona who kills a vedalken to get himself detained in the Azorius Detention Compound and escape Bilagru.

entities.name: Ilona
entities.description: Orzhov kingpin who lends Symond money for his play and intends to collect.

entities.name: Lord Kazmyr
entities.description: Ilona's bound thrull, a small gray winged figure in a gold mask who repeats that Bilagru will come.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: Giant armored Orzhov debt collector with a double-bladed axe who comes for Symond.

entities.name: Zandra
aliases: the child who led the Legion
entities.description: Child who led the Legion; subject of Symond's play, who duels the Demon of the Spire.

entities.name: Demon of the Spire
entities.description: Foe Zandra duels in the final scene of Symond's play.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Ravnican guild of debt and finance, symbolized by the Orzhov guild sun.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnican guild of law whose arresters enforce detention law.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild whose mages built the stage for Symond's play.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane of guilds where the story takes place.

entities.name: Detention Compound
entities.description: Azorius prison where Symond is held.

entities.name: Azorius Tenth District
entities.description: District of Ravnica where Symond plans his escape.

events.summary: Symond is arrested by Azorius arresters over a body, and sees a cloaked Orzhov rider on a horse as he is taken away.
events.quote: Symond found himself being ushered away under the guard of a half dozen arresters.

events.summary: In flashback, Symond asks Ilona for money for his play about Zandra.
events.quote: because I want to put on a play.

events.summary: Ilona has Lord Kazmyr bring a contract, and Symond signs, incurring a debt to her.
events.quote: "This is an investment. You are incurring a debt. To me."

events.summary: Lord Kazmyr whispers that Bilagru will come for Symond.
events.quote: I heard the thrull whisper, "Bilagru will come for you."

events.summary: On opening night the play's audience is thin and Ilona is in the balcony, leaving Symond in debt; he flees.
events.quote: Only a quarter of the seats were occupied, but there, sitting in her balcony seat, was Ilona.

events.summary: Lord Kazmyr calls Symond a debtor and warns that Bilagru is coming; Symond runs.
events.quote: "Bilagru is coming for you," came a voice from above me.

events.summary: Symond kills a vedalken courier in the Azorius Tenth District so that arresters will take him into custody.
events.quote: I drew my sword and plunged it into his chest.

events.summary: In his cell Symond finds an Orzhov coin and sees Lord Kazmyr at the window as chaos erupts among the guards.
events.quote: Lord Kazmyr was staring back at him.

events.summary: Bilagru breaks into the cell and tells Symond that debts must be paid, raising his axe.
events.quote: "You are a debtor to Ilona of the Orzhov."

relations.quote: the Orzhov kingpin's flair for the theatrical
